notices.description:
The Administration for Childrens Services intends to renew its contract with Young Adult Institute, Inc. for the continued provision of Essential Parenting Supports parenting skills training program. Young Adult Institute, Inc. headquarters is located at 220 East 42nd Street, 8th Floor, New York, NY 10017. Renewing this program will allow ACS to continue providing year-round parenting skills training and support to parents and caregivers with a suspected cognitive limitation or confirmed Intellectual / Developmental Disabilities (I/DD). Parents referred to the program receive tailored parenting classes, one-on-one parenting coaching, and case management services that connect them to additional support and resources. The renewal term of this contract is October 1, 2026, through September 30, 2029. The renewal total contract amount is $1,798,402.50, and the EPIN is 06823P0006001R001.

This notice is for informational purposes only. Anyone who would like to share comments or concerns regarding the providers performance and other factors relevant to the renewal, may contact Keshia Wyllie via email at keshia.wyllie…

The Department of Homeless Services  is seeking appropriately qualified contractors/vendors to contract for the provision of shelter services for families with children, adult families, and single adults who are temporarily housed in DHS contracted commercial hotels. The selected vendors will provide services as outlined in this RFP to assist clients with their daily needs and to help them move out of the shelter system as quickly as possible.

notices.short_title: ADJUSTMENT IN HUDSON YARDS DISTRICT IMPROVEMENT BONUS CONTRIBUTION AMOUNT
notices.description:
ADJUSTMENT IN HUDSON YARDS DISTRICT IMPROVEMENT BONUS CONTRIBUTION AMOUNT

 

As provided in Section 93-31 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York, the required contribution amount per square foot of bonused floor area available through the District Improvement Fund Bonus in the Special Hudson Yards District has been increased from $169.68 per square foot to $175.62 per square foot as of August 1, 2026. 

In accordance with Section 93-31, this increase is based on the change in the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPI), as published by the U.S. Department of Labor, Bureau of Labor Statistics.  The CPI change for the period between July 1, 2025 and July 1, 2026 was an increase of 3.5 percent.

This increased contribution amount per square foot of bonused floor area applies to all contributions pursuant to Section 93-31 received after July 31, 2026, until s…
notices.plain: The Department of City Planning raised the required contribution per square foot of bonused floor area in the Hudson Yards District Improvement Fund Bonus from $169.68 to $175.62, effective Aug. 1, 2026, reflecting a 3.5 percent consumer price increase.
The notice gives only its title, so the sentence restates it: the Office of the Mayor published Executive Order No. 19 in The City Record on July 30, 2026.
